documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Rolex Rings Limited reported its Q2 & H1 FY27 financial performance, achieving its highest quarterly revenue of Rs. 389 crore, up 43% year-on-year. Automotive components drove performance with a 68% revenue increase to Rs. 177 crore, while monthly order inflows averaged Rs. 120 crore to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects H2 FY27 performance to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings expects revenue from the defence and aerospace segment over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

guidance.claim: Supplies to one to two new customer plants are scheduled to begin in Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in achieving its mid-teen revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2027.
guidance.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

guidance.claim: Management conservatively projects EBITDA margin to be between 21% and 22% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth to approach 20% in fiscal 2028.
guidance.quote: On the revenue part, as I have indicated, mid-teen; we are a bit confident till now for fiscal '27 and maybe more than mid-teen or coming close to the 20% number for fiscal '28.

guidance.claim: Management expects auto component exports to reach between INR 425 crores to INR 450 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: Not INR500 crores, but I'm a bit confident to cross between INR425 crores to INR450 crores.

guidance.claim: Rolex Rings has provided a mid-teen growth guidance heading into the rest of FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

demand_outlook.claim: Rolex Rings achieved its strongest quarterly performance in Q2 FY27 with revenue growing 43% year-on-year to Rs. 389 crore.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 has been the strongest quarter in our history. Revenue from operations grew 43% year-on-year to Rs. 389 crore, which includes a one-time receipt of around Rs. 18 crore from the refund of customs duty paid on US tariffs.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive component revenues increased by 68% year-on-year to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in the segment growing by 89%.
demand_outlook.quote: Automotive components led the quarter, growing 68% to Rs. 177 crore, with exports in this segment up 89%.

demand_outlook.claim: US automotive revenues for the company more than doubled year-on-year during Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: US tariffs have not impacted our business. Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers who had paused orders during FY26 have resumed placing orders.
demand_outlook.quote: Customers who held back through FY26 are placing orders with confidence again, and the new programmes we won last year are now scaling up.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand overseas is picking up as international customers resume placing orders with confidence.
demand_outlook.quote: That shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up and that the relationship we have built with these customers, these multinationals over the years, remains intact and are now translating back to the order flow.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the bearing ring segment remains strong within passenger vehicles and LCV applications.
demand_outlook.quote: No. In the bearing ring, the segment is passenger vehicle LCV, where we are getting good demand or good incremental demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Operations in Europe continue to grow due to expanding automotive components presence in the region.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to fire on the back of our expanding automotive components presence there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that buyers who held back in FY26 are now placing orders again with confidence.
demand_outlook.quote: What stands out most is a change in customer behaviour - buyers who had been cautious and holding back through FY26 are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas demand is picking up as international customers resume ordering.
demand_outlook.quote: This shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up.

demand_outlook.claim: The operational constraint in Q1 FY27 was worker availability rather than customer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The constraint was labour availability, not demand.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 9MW solar power plant is scheduled to be setup by mid-CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

capex_expansion.claim: The company targets annual capital expenditure in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring inorganic growth and potential joint venture opportunities with an overseas player to set up operations in India.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also looking for inorganic growth or maybe some association or some JV with an overseas player to be based in India, wherein the base of the utilization of Rolex facilities will increase and more value-added processes where the third party has some expertise and a ready market available.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55% while EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore considering one time receipt.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 22.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved due to product mix optimization, raw material management, and plant-level cost controls.
margins_costs.quote: Coming to the margin side, as you must have seen, gross margins for the quarter have come up compared to fiscal '26 or on a Q1 FY26, reflecting both a favorable shift in product mix as well as disciplined raw material management and scientific production measures, cost control areas at our plant level.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 4% to Rs. 304 crores alongside improvements in gross margins and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 4% to Rs. 304 crores with Gross Margins & profitability improving.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly order book average remains between Rs. 120 crore and Rs. 125 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book continues to remain strong, averaging in the range of Rs.120 crores to Rs 125 crores per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilisation stood at 63-65% during the period.
orders_capacity.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization currently stands at 63% to 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are at the same 63% to 65% utilization, you can say.

orders_capacity.claim: Management aims to increase capacity utilization to 70%-72% during the current year.
orders_capacity.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

orders_capacity.claim: Rolex Rings registered its highest monthly revenue since inception in July 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: I would like to inform or pleased to inform that in month July '26, we recorded the highest revenue since the inception of our operations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintained a healthy order book throughout Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed a share buyback of Rs. 180 crore and maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: With a debt-free balance sheet, the Rs. 180 crore buyback completed, and a strong pipeline across Europe, the US and India, we head into H2 FY27 with confidence.

capital_allocation.claim: The company concluded an INR 180 crore equity share buyback without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Would like to inform you that our INR180 crores buyback of 1 crores equity shares concluded during the quarter, with the promoter group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed directly to non-promoter shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt-free and cleared of legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings completed a Rs. 180 crore buyback during the quarter with no promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 180 crore buyback got concluded during the quarter, with the Promoter Group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed to our public shareholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shop floor labor shortages restricted production output during part of Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

risks_headwinds.claim: A shop floor labour shortage delayed the conversion of the order book into finished output during Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of workers on the shop floor meant we couldn't convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business operations have not been impacted by US tariffs and are normalizing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the US imposing tariffs, business has not been affected and is coming back to normalcy.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects H2 FY27 performance to be stronger than H1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

management_commitments.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

management_commitments.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.
